ProjectsDone.title: Colombia’s First Legal Subscription Platform
ProjectsDone.description: A SaaS platform providing 24/7 AI-powered legal assistance, monthly subscription plans, and smart scheduling for specialized legal consultations.
about: Legal Aid is Colombia’s first legal subscription service — an innovative platform built on the belief that justice should be a right for all, not a privilege for the few who can afford it.

In a region marked by deep inequalities, Legal Aid disrupts the traditional legal model by offering high-quality legal advice and representation through affordable monthly plans — without hidden fees or economic barriers.
Born from a commitment to more humane justice, Legal Aid blends technology, artificial intelligence, and people-first design to provide legal support to both individuals and businesses.

The platform delivers a complete digital legal ecosystem, including a 24/7 AI legal assistant, specialized lawyer scheduling, legal case management, and access to multiple legal practice areas from a single user-friendly interface.
solution: We developed a complete ecosystem using Next.js, Supabase, and PostgreSQL, deployed on Vercel for high scalability and uptime.
Implemented a 24/7 AI-powered legal assistant capable of answering legal questions, analyzing documents, and drafting legal texts in real time.
Built a legal plan subscription system that offers a defined number of consultations per practice area, such as family, civil, labor, criminal, and consumer law.
Created a smart scheduling system for booking appointments with specialized lawyers, integrated with Google Calendar for virtual or in-person meetings.
Developed a legal case management module that allows users to document legal processes, upload files, track case stages, generate reports, and assign attorneys.
Included an advanced admin dashboard to configure AI knowledge (FAQs, laws, files), manage users, legal areas, metrics, and payment tracking.
Added features for automatic renewals, payment history, co-pay management, and consultation usage tracking by legal line.
features: Legal Subscription Plans by Practice Area
Full Legal Case Management and PDF Reporting
Admin Panel with AI Configuration and Content Control
Real-Time Metrics and User Analytics Dashboard

ProjectsDone.title: Personalized Pet Care Services
ProjectsDone.description: A visually engaging and user-friendly landing page for FITPup, a premium pet care service provider.
about: FITPup is a provider of personalized pet care services focused on animal health and well-being. With over 25 years of experience, they offer services such as walking, training, nutrition plans, and transportation in Palm Beach and its surroundings.
FITPup is located in Palm Beach and serves clients throughout the surrounding area, providing exclusive services to ensure the well-being of pets.
Their mission is to provide high-quality care with a personalized approach, ensuring that each pet receives the best possible care tailored to their specific needs.
FITPup combines professionalism with a passion for animals, creating a community of pet owners who trust their services to improve their furry companions' quality of life.
solution: For the creation of the landing page, we worked closely with the FITPup team to capture the essence of their brand and convey their message clearly and attractively.
A fresh and dynamic design was chosen, incorporating animated visual elements, vibrant colors, and an intuitive structure to enhance user experience.

The landing page features an eye-catching hero section, a frequently asked questions (FAQ) section, a carousel of highlighted services, and a multimedia gallery with photos and videos of pets cared for by FITPup.
We implemented a blog powered by Sanity, allowing FITPup to share tips and updates on pet care.

A multi-step online form was developed for users to request services. The form guides pet owners through different stages: acceptance of terms and conditions with a digital signature, owner and contact information, veterinary details, and pet profile registration, including vaccination documents.
For form submission management, we used Resend, ensuring FITPup receives all information in real time, including attached files and the client's signature.
Optimizations were applied to improve loading speed, making it fast and efficient across all devices.
features: Multi-step Online Form with Digital Signature

ProjectsDone.title: Comprehensive Wellness Platform
ProjectsDone.description: A modern and attractive landing page for Mobien, a comprehensive wellness platform that combines education, finance, and health.
about: Mobien is an innovative platform designed to help people achieve their personal goals and transform their lives through educational, financial, and wellness tools.
With a focus on continuous improvement, Mobien offers motivational content, financial advice, and health strategies that empower its community.
Its mission is to provide accessible and valuable resources so that users can achieve a balanced and healthy life by combining education and technology.
Mobien seeks to inspire its users through its YouTube channel, where it shares valuable content on personal growth, financial education, and physical and mental well-being.
solution: For the construction of Mobien's landing page, we developed a modern and vibrant design with neon green and bluish colors, conveying a sense of innovation and energy.
We implemented an attractive hero section that captures the user's attention from the first moment, reinforcing the brand's identity and its central message.
The YouTube API was integrated to automatically display the latest videos published on Mobien's channel, keeping the page updated and dynamic.
We included a sticky cards section highlighting the different services and values that Mobien offers, providing an interactive and clear experience for visitors.
The landing page features a responsive design, ensuring a smooth experience across mobile devices, tablets, and desktops.
Loading optimizations were applied to ensure the page is fast and efficient, offering seamless navigation.
A light and dark mode (Light/Dark Mode) was incorporated to enhance accessibility and personalize the user experience.
It includes a subscription form to capture leads and keep the audience updated with the latest news and offers, managed through Resend.

ProjectsDone.title: Bringing Communities Together
ProjectsDone.description: A modern and attractive landing page for a platform that enables the creation of communities and courses, enhanced with artificial intelligence.
about: GroupIA is a vibrant platform designed to facilitate the creation of online communities, allowing users to connect, collaborate, and strengthen their relationships.
Inspired by platforms like Skool but with significant improvements, GroupIA incorporates artificial intelligence to automate and optimize community and course management.
Users can integrate various social networks, set up automation workflows with AI agents, and customize their community with advanced administration tools.
With an intuitive and modern interface, GroupIA provides all the necessary tools to manage courses, discussion forums, and multiple communication channels in a single platform.
solution: For the development of GroupIA’s landing page, a modern interface was designed with a combination of orange, black, and white colors, adapting to both light and dark modes.
The page is fully responsive, offering an optimal experience on any device and ensuring smooth and engaging navigation.
It features a highly interactive hero section with dynamic 3D effects and animated spheres that capture the user's attention from the first moment.
Several informative sections highlight the platform's benefits, emphasizing the ability to create private communities, customized courses, and AI-powered tools.
A translation API integration was implemented to support multiple languages, allowing users to easily switch between English and Spanish.
Additionally, the landing page is optimized for SEO, ensuring high performance in search engines and improving the platform’s visibility.
It includes a sign-up and login form that allows users to subscribe and start using the platform, with customization options and pricing plans tailored to each community's needs.
A subscription via Resend was added to capture leads and keep users informed about updates and new features.

ProjectsDone.title: Intelligent Assessment Platform
ProjectsDone.description: Application for the creation and management of academic tests with personalized learning path generation.
about: Coingenia allows institutions and organizations to create academic tests and efficiently assign them to their students.
Each student receives an email with their credentials upon being registered in the system.
Institutions can create test categories, upload images, and manage assessments from a centralized platform.
The system includes a dashboard to visualize student results in real-time.
solution: We developed an intuitive platform for creating and assigning academic tests.
The system automatically notifies students via email with their usernames and passwords.
A dashboard with key metrics was implemented to analyze student performance.
The software generates personalized learning paths at the end of each technical test, allowing students to study only what they need to improve.

ProjectsDone.title: Intelligent Route and Vehicle Management
ProjectsDone.description: Platform for managing routes, vehicles, and drivers with automated assignments and detailed reports.
about: Localizamos allows administrators to create multiple entities, each with its own fleet of vehicles, routes, and drivers.
Entities can assign drivers to a specific vehicle and route with their respective operating schedule.
Drivers can log into the platform and view their assigned vehicles, as well as the route and schedule they must follow.
The platform includes a reports section where entities can review the history of completed routes and which driver carried out each one.
solution: We developed an intuitive platform for managing and assigning vehicles, routes, and drivers.
The system allows administrators to schedule movement times and ensure better route planning.
Drivers receive clear information about their assigned vehicle and the established schedules for their route.
A detailed reporting module was implemented to analyze the history of completed routes for each driver.

ProjectsDone.title: AI Chatbot Integration
about: ChatGenius develops intelligent chatbots to enhance customer service and automate interactions.
Our platform allows response customization and continuous learning to provide a better experience.
solution: We designed a chatbot with natural language processing (NLP) to accurately answer questions.
Machine learning was implemented to continuously improve the chatbot's responses.
Integration with multiple platforms, including websites and social media.

ProjectsDone.title: E-commerce Store Focused on Printing, Design, and Creation
ProjectsDone.description: An e-commerce store developed in Shopify, specializing in personalized printing on a wide variety of products.
about: Pura Impresión is an online store specializing in product printing and customization for businesses and consumers.
We offer prints on various items such as canvases, pillows, tablecloths, photographs, puzzles, mousepads, and more.
Our catalog includes options such as kraft bags, non-woven bags, menu cards, die-cut stickers, hanging banners, spider banners, postcard calendars, and round stickers.
We offer nationwide shipping, ensuring a reliable and efficient shopping experience.
We have a subscription system that allows users to obtain exclusive discounts on recurring purchases.
Additionally, customers can register on our platform to manage their purchase history and access exclusive benefits.
solution: We developed an e-commerce store with Shopify, focused on a smooth and attractive user experience.
We implemented a modern, elegant, and responsive design optimized for all devices.
Multiple payment methods were integrated, including PayPal, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Wompi, Efecty, and Baloto.
The store was optimized for SEO, ensuring visibility in search engines and improving customer conversion.
We included a subscription system that allows users to obtain discounts and special benefits.
A login system was implemented so that customers can manage their purchase history and track their orders.

ProjectsDone.title: Collaborative Consulting, Transformative Results
ProjectsDone.description: A modern and optimized landing page for Kalosys, a U.S.-based IT consulting firm offering integration, data management, and cloud solutions.
about: Kalosys is an IT consulting firm that helps businesses optimize their technological infrastructure, improve data management, and efficiently adopt cloud solutions.
Its innovative approach enables organizations to maximize their technology investments, ensuring smooth and secure operations.
With a team of technology experts, Kalosys positions itself as a strategic partner for companies looking to modernize their systems, enhance security, and improve operational resilience.
Kalosys not only implements solutions but also provides continuous support to ensure long-term success for its clients.
solution: A modern and professional landing page was developed to reflect Kalosys’ brand identity, using a sophisticated and corporate color palette to convey seriousness and trust.
The site includes multiple informative pages detailing Kalosys’ services, team, work methodology, and success stories.
A content management system was implemented using Sanity, allowing the company to update content easily and efficiently.
SEO optimization was a key focus, ensuring Kalosys has a strong presence in search engines.
An integrated blog section was included to share relevant content on technology, innovation, and IT best practices.
Responsive and accessible design, ensuring a seamless experience across mobile devices, tablets, and desktops.
